intent: Implement InMemoryValidatedSampleStream (Java 21, Spring Boot 3, WebFlux/Reactor/R2DBC, constructor injection, no blocking calls) so that the frozen test passes, providing exactly the ast_hints table and nothing improvised. Unit contract: Infrastructure adapter implementing ValidatedSampleStream with Sinks.many().multicast().onBackpressureBuffer(properties.validatedStreamCapacity(), false) (autoCancel false so a subscriber disconnect never terminates ingestion). publish emits with emitNext and Sinks.EmitFailureHandler.busyLooping(properties.emitRetryTimeout()); on FAIL_OVERFLOW or FAIL_TERMINATED it returns Mono.error(IllegalStateException). No unbounded buffer, no blocking. Registered ONLY by the wiring unit TelemetryConfiguration.
